Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract specific registry data (registered name, incorporation date, etc.) from the Datocapital page shown in Step 3, despite the page being visible in the search results. Instead, it immediately launched a new search in Step 4 for the Cayman Islands General Registry without first navigating to the Datocapital link or extracting the available information. This missed opportunity to gather the exact registered company name (Phoenix Satellite Television Holdings Ltd) from a third-party registry source that was already accessible delayed the process and resulted in an incomplete analysis of the available evidence.
